description: The "Baseline" Category: Most women fall in this group, with no major known risk indicators.
The "Watchful" Category: You have a few mild risk indicators that may be worth monitoring over time.
recommendation: Continue routine screening. Yearly mammography based screening is mandatory.

description: The "Increased" Category: You have at least one strong risk indicator that places you at a moderately elevated risk.
recommendation: Routine screening with yearly mammography being mandatory. Supplemental screening is needed as well.

description: The "Intensive" Category: You are at the highest risk and need closer clinical attention.
recommendation: Routine screening with yearly mammography being mandatory. Additional annual screening including breast MRI is desirable. Genetic counseling and relatives screening might be necessary.
